title: Video
description: A video of YouTube or Vimeo, or a file of the media library, with a poster and a caption. A video of another site waits for the visitor’s consent to media and plays on a click.

schema.label: Address on YouTube or Vimeo
schema.help: Any address the video is shared by: watch, youtu.be, shorts, a channel’s, an unlisted one.

schema.label: Video of the library
schema.help: MP4 or WebM. Plays on the site itself: no consent asked.

schema.label: Poster
schema.help: Empty: a link shows the video’s own preview, fetched once into the library; a file shows an empty frame until it plays.
